verdict.rationale: Financial Connections documents a test mode where the authentication flow shows Stripe-managed test institutions that can be linked without credentials. A client method launches the flow from a server-issued client_secret, and a community user reports that 'Start Now' drops straight into the test dashboard, which suggests self-serve sandbox access. The evidence names an npm package and an official CLI but shows no quickstart. missing for 10: explicit self-serve API key docs, a runnable end-to-end quickstart, a documented list of client libraries across languages, independent reports on time-to-first-link.

support.subject: As a developer, I can go from signup to my first linked sandbox account fast — self-serve API keys, a runnable quickstart, and client libraries in my language

citations.quote: the authentication flow exclusively shows a selection of test institutions managed by Stripe. The client can link accounts from any of these institutions without providing credentials.
Use collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts to launch the authentication flow from your client using the client_secret returned by your server
By clicking 'Start Now', I try to visit dashboard.stripe.com/financial-connections/application and it redirects to the test dashboard.
When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
